title: Tribology
description: Every machine wears where its parts slide. Archard: the volume worn away is V = k·W·L/H, the load times the distance slid over the hardness, with a wear coefficient k for the pair. A hard, slippery coating (diamond-like carbon) cuts both the friction and k by orders of magnitude. Unlocks the Tribometer and the Wear Coating upgrade.

puzzle.goal: A part slides a distance L under a load W against a surface of hardness H; the pair has wear coefficient k. Write the volume V worn away.
puzzle.name: Archard's wear law
puzzle.ask: Find V in m³ for k = @{k}, W = @{W} N, L = @{L} m and H = @{H} Pa.
puzzle.method: Asperities touch over an area W/H; a fixed fraction k of the contacts tears off a lump as it slides.
